Subtitle Editor Online — Initial Release

- Launches a cloud-based subtitle editor for easy video captioning and export.
- Supports uploading MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM videos up to 500MB.
- Add accurate subtitles in multiple languages (e.g., English, Spanish) with auto-synced timestamps.
- Exports videos in 1080p MP4 format within about 30–90 seconds.
- User-friendly: no complex software; just upload, specify instructions, and download.
- Built-in free credits system and seamless backend connection for all users.
